name: feedback-loop
$comment: Thumbs-down ×3 on runs where hints were applied (recall: true makes appliedHintIds the real provenance). Each down multiplies confidence by downFactor (inferred 0.6, explicit 0.8) and counts a contradiction. Below 0.3: inferred → retired, explicit → pending + needsReview. At 3 contradictions: inferred → retired, explicit → needsReview but still active. Confidences are scripted so all three outcomes land on the third down: inferred 0.9 → 0.19 (retired), explicit 0.7 → 0.36 (needsReview, active), explicit 0.55 → 0.28 (pending).

steps.note: An inferred hint: the extractor reads a habit out of a plain question (scripted; source = inferred because it comes from a turn).
